title: Gemini in everyday life

body.text: Gemini makes daily life easier in
every situation — from planning trips, cooking, and scheduling, to learning a new language
. Just describe the problem or need, and Gemini helps you think, analyze, and find a solution right away.

example: "Help me plan next week's schedule — I have 3 meetings, 2 deliverables to submit, and I want to work out 4 days."

title: Recap of everything you've learned

body.text: Throughout this course you've learned Gemini's basics, its multimodal abilities, its integration with Google Workspace, and how to build Gems. The
key is to actually use it every day
— the more you use it, the more new ways you'll discover for Gemini to improve your life and work.

example: "Set a goal: use Gemini at least once a day for 7 days, and notice how it helps you."

question: Which is the best example of using Gemini in everyday life?

options.text: Using Gemini as an alarm clock
Having Gemini help plan a trip and organize your weekly schedule
Having Gemini post on social media for you every day

question: Which best summarizes everything you learned about Gemini's capabilities?

options.text: Gemini can only chat and answer questions
Gemini is a multimodal AI integrated with Google Workspace that can build Gems

question: What's the best way to build your Gemini skills?

options.text: Actually use it every day and try it on many kinds of work

question: To get the most out of Gemini in daily life, what should you do?

options.text: Use it through Gmail/Docs/Search that you already use every day

question: Which everyday Gemini uses can you start with right now?

options.text: Summarizing emails, drafting documents, and searching with verification
